name: focus-notes
description: Focus Notes: a calm, Markdown-native writing app with notes in your own GitHub.

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter ./packages/** run build && pnpm --filter @focus-notes/desktop run build
scripts.check:generated: node apps/desktop/scripts/icon.mjs --check && node apps/desktop/scripts/portable-splash.mjs --check && node apps/web/scripts/entry.mjs --check && node tools/component-inventory.mjs --check && node tools/release/store-assets.mjs --check && node tools/release/store-listing.mjs --check
scripts.check: pnpm run check:boundaries && pnpm run check:kits && pnpm run check:chain && pnpm run check:plan && pnpm run check:licenses && pnpm run check:generated && pnpm run ui:check
scripts.test:web: pnpm --filter @focus-notes/web run build && pnpm --filter @focus-notes/web run test:e2e
